candidate: C3_r2 (C2 + lever 9a/9b longer arms + wrist; refine r2: ovoid head, chest blend, lower chest roll, rounder chest/back, arm bands only at joints, monotonic leg covers)
note: Verdicts, reads_as and pairwise verbatim from the blind design-critic (Sonnet); evidence abridged by the author.

reports.reads_as_reason: Stacked slab-and-block segments (chest slab with a hard underside ledge, box backpack, cuffed shanks, wedge feet) and wing-like wide arms read as a prototype shell, not a unibody product.
reports.pairwise_evidence: Thin joint rings and dark hand tips replace the heavy graphite arm bands; smoother arm taper. Torso, backpack, legs and feet unchanged. Small margin.
top_changes: G6: pull the arms in, narrow shoulder and upper arm, slope the shoulder line, lower the splay
G2: blend chest into waist and pelvis; remove the underside ledge; shrink chest depth toward the waist
G4: lower n on back pack and pelvis; soften shank cuffs; taper shank; shorten foot

reports.reads_as_reason: The two-tone is calmer than the baseline, but the huge boxy shoulder and arm masses, stepped chest-to-torso ledge, block pelvis and oversized feet still read as a prototype or character, not a unibody product.
reports.pairwise_evidence: Removes the zebra arm bands; legs calmer (S3b 7 -> 3), n_pass 14 vs 13. Costs: P3 0.365 vs 0.358 and slightly lower IoU. Modest improvement.
top_changes: G6: narrow shoulders, arms closer to the body
G2: blend chest, waist and pelvis into one form
G4: chest, pelvis, head and back pack in the limbs' squareness family
